record.paper_title: Some open problems of Ramsey minimal graphs.
record.original_question: Let F, G, and H be non-empty graphs, and write F → (G, H) to mean that every red-blue coloring of the edges of F contains either a red copy of G or a blue copy of H. A graph F is Ramsey (G, H)-minimal if F → (G, H) but, for every edge e of F, the graph F − e fails to satisfy F − e → (G, H). Let ℜ(G, H) denote the set of all Ramsey (G, H)-minimal graphs. For each integer t ≥ 6, classify all 2-connected graphs in ℜ(2K2, tK2), where 2K2 is the matching consisting of two disjoint edges and tK2 is the matching consisting of t disjoint edges.

evidence.quote: F, G, and H, say that F → (G, H) if whenever the edges of F are 2-colored, say with red and blue, there is either a red copy of G or a blue copy of H. A graph F is called Ramsey (G, H)-minimal if F → (G, H) but for any edge e ∈ E(F), we have (F - e) ↛ (G, H). The set of all Ramsey (G, H)-minimal graphs, the topic of this note, is denoted by ℜ(G, H).
Problem 1. For each t ≥ 6, characterize all 2-connected graphs in ℜ(2K2, tK2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let all graphs be finite, simple, and undirected. For graphs $F, G, H$, write $F \to (G, H)$ if for every coloring of the edges of $F$ with two colors red and blue, $F$ contains either a red subgraph isomorphic to $G$ or a blue subgraph isomorphic to $H$. A graph $F$ is called Ramsey $(G,H)$-minimal if $F \to (G,H)$ and, for every edge $e \in E(F)$, the graph $F - e$ does not satisfy $F - e \to (G,H)$. Let $\mathfrak{R}(G,H)$ denote the class of all Ramsey $(G,H)$-minimal graphs (up to isomorphism). For an integer $k \geq 1$, let $kK_2$ denote the matching consisting of $k$ pairwise vertex-disjoint edges.

Problem: For each integer $t \geq 6$, characterize (i.e., give an explicit description of) all 2-connected graphs that belong to $\mathfrak{R}(2K_2, tK_2)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate that $\mathfrak{R}(2K_2,tK_2)$ has been characterized in terms of factor-critical graphs and explicitly determined for $t \le 5$, but no source was found that completes the characterization of 2-connected members for $t \ge 6$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Ramsey minimal graphs for 2K2 versus Pn (ResearchGate)
status_evidence.snippet: Members of R(2K2,tK2) characterized via factor-critical graphs; sets determined for t ≤ 5.
status_evidence.claim: Only small cases t ≤ 5 are completely determined; the 2-connected case for t ≥ 6 is not resolved in the cited literature.

status_evidence.title: The Complete List of Ramsey (2K2,K4)-Minimal Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of (2K2,H)-minimal graphs for various H, with matching results known only for small t.
status_evidence.claim: Research on Ramsey (2K2,·)-minimal graphs is active, but a characterization of 2-connected members of R(2K2,tK2) for t ≥ 6 has not been published.
